Name: BlendShape
Description: This will create blendshapes for the selected geo

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: This will create blendshapes for the selected geo. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetGeo: set the node/object name this block should use. NewNames: enter names separated by commas (example format: nameA,nameB,nameC). Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
